author: The Infographics Show
description:
The job market isn’t just cooling off, it’s fundamentally changing.
Fewer openings, more competition, and a growing sense that the system itself isn’t working like it used to.

This breakdown of This is why It’s so hard to find a job right now dives into the real forces behind the struggle: unstable tariffs, persistent inflation, AI-driven job cuts, and a hiring process that feels more broken than ever.
From “ghost jobs” to mass layoffs and shrinking entry-level opportunities, the path into the workforce is getting narrower by the day.

Because right now, it’s not just hard to get a job, it’s hard to even get a chance.
